finding.zh: 成功停止相对注意捕获后继续反应，在右额下回等区域出现更高的 beta 源功率。选取表 1 的四个皮层峰值。
finding.en: Successful stopping versus continuing after attentional capture increased beta source power in right inferior frontal and related cortical areas. Four cortical peaks from Table 1 are included.

condition.zh: sSTOP > cAC-GO；刺激选择性停止任务，beta 源功率
condition.en: sSTOP > cAC-GO; stimulus-selective stopping, beta source power

sample.zh: 59 名健康成人（62 名入组，3 名排除）

roiDefinition.zh: MEG beamformer 源重建，1 cm 网格；表 1 组水平对比峰值
roiDefinition.en: MEG beamformer reconstruction on a 1 cm grid; group contrast peaks in Table 1

limitations.zh: 源定位依赖模型和网格；这些是统计峰值而非电极位置。表 1 未明确 MNI 模板变体，不能直接贴到当前解剖模板。
limitations.en: Source estimates depend on the model and grid; these are statistical peaks, not electrodes. The table does not specify the MNI template variant.

finding.zh: 在 20 体素 ROI 主分析中，右 FFA 的著名人物身份解码高于随机水平，并通过 12 个 ROI 的 Bonferroni 校正。
finding.en: In the primary 20-voxel ROI analysis, famous-face identity decoding in right FFA exceeded chance after Bonferroni correction across 12 ROIs.

condition.zh: 两名著名人物，每人 8 张图；独立首轮定位，其余轮次身份解码
condition.en: Two famous identities, 8 images each; first run used for localization, remaining runs for decoding

sample.zh: 17 名纳入；右 FFA 可定位者 16 名

roiDefinition.zh: 首轮 face > cup 定位；20 个连续选择性体素，160 mm³；坐标是 ROI 的跨被试平均位置
roiDefinition.en: First-run face > cup localizer; 20 contiguous selective voxels, 160 mm³; coordinate is the across-subject average ROI location

limitations.zh: 局部扫描覆盖；ROI 均值不是组水平解码峰值，也不代表全部面孔身份编码位置。
limitations.en: Limited scan coverage. The ROI mean is not a group decoding peak and does not identify every site coding face identity.

finding.zh: 同一 20 体素主分析中，左 FFA 解码在未校正水平高于随机，但未通过 12 个 ROI 的校正。
finding.en: In the same 20-voxel analysis, left FFA decoding exceeded chance without correction but did not survive correction across 12 ROIs.

condition.zh: 两名著名人物身份解码，与右 FFA 使用相同任务
condition.en: Famous-face identity decoding, same task as right FFA

sample.zh: 17 名纳入；左 FFA 可定位者 13 名

roiDefinition.zh: 首轮独立 face > cup 定位，20 体素；跨被试 ROI 平均坐标
roiDefinition.en: Independent first-run face > cup localizer, 20 voxels; across-subject mean ROI coordinate

direction.zh: 未通过多重比较校正：t(12)=2.57，p=.012（正文）
direction.en: Not significant after multiple-comparison correction: t(12)=2.57, p=.012 (main text)

limitations.zh: 未显著不能证明左 FFA 不含身份信息；样本量与右 FFA 不同。正文 p=.012，表 2 将 p 四舍五入为 .01。
limitations.en: A nonsignificant corrected result does not establish absence of identity information. Sample sizes differ. Main text p=.012; Table 2 rounds to .01.

finding.zh: 协议 1 采用右侧 TPJ 或 hMT/V5+ 的 rTMS 检验下落目标拦截的时间控制。坐标为实际刺激点的组均值。
finding.en: Protocol 1 used right TPJ or hMT/V5+ rTMS to examine interception timing for descending targets. Coordinates summarize the actual stimulation sites.

condition.zh: 协议 1：rTMS 前后比较；自然重力或反重力下落目标；反应时控制任务
condition.en: Protocol 1: before/after rTMS; gravity-consistent or reversed-gravity descent; reaction-time control

sample.zh: 协议 1 共 12 名，TPJ 与 hMT/V5+ 各 6 名；其中 6 名也接受另一靶点刺激
sample.en: Protocol 1: 12 participants, 6 per initial target; 6 also received stimulation of the other target

roiDefinition.zh: 根据既往 fMRI 设置靶点并以个体 MRI 导航；表 1 报告实际刺激位置的 MNI 均值
roiDefinition.en: Targets based on prior fMRI and navigated using individual MRI; Table 1 reports mean actual MNI stimulation positions

direction.zh: 拦截反应提前；TPJ 效应依赖重力一致性，hMT/V5+ 的效应更广
direction.en: Earlier interception responses; TPJ effects depended on gravity consistency, hMT/V5+ effects were broader

limitations.zh: 刺激范围与网络效应不能由单一坐标表示；这些是刺激位置而非 BOLD 激活峰值。区域关联是宏观阅读线索。
limitations.en: Stimulation spread and network effects cannot be represented by a single point. These are stimulation positions, not BOLD peaks; anatomical links are broad reading associations.
